title: Dimethyl sulfide found on exoplanets as a sign of life elsewhere

tellings.quote: 120 uh light years away from us like we we found some dimethyl sulfide the dimethyl dulfide

plain: Scientists have found dimethyl sulfide, a chemical the story treats as a possible sign of life, on planets around other stars about 120 light years from Earth. A guest named Chris Gilbert mentions it in passing on the show, without naming a source. If it holds up, it would hint that life exists beyond Earth.
